record.question: BBC stands for
record.explanation: The Royal Charter continuing the BBC until 31 December 2016 names British Broadcasting Corporation. British Broadcasting Company was its predecessor, not its name at the October 2016 exam. Historical exam context: 2016-10 (month/year printed). This is the source-era answer; time-sensitive roles, rankings and memberships may have changed. Evidence: https://downloads.bbc.co.uk/bbctrust/assets/files/pdf/about/how_we_govern/charter.pdf Independently checked solution, unofficial. No matching examiner answer key is asserted.
